title: Openbase
claim: Product Hunt: Openbase — Manage your team of AI agents by voice, from anywhere
why_good: Manage a team of AI agents by voice from anywhere — a novel mobile-first control layer as people run more background agents.
value: Prosumer/team subscription for operators of many agents; the wedge is voice + remote control of agent fleets.
risk: Early and broad; voice control of agents is unproven UX, and the agent platforms may add native remote control.
evidence: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Tech
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Openbase —— 随时随地用语音管理你的 AI agent 团队。
zh.why_good: 随时随地用语音管理一队 AI agent——随着人们跑更多后台 agent,一个新颖的移动优先控制层。
zh.value: 给管很多 agent 的操作者卖专业/团队订阅;切口是语音 + 远程控制 agent 舰队。
zh.risk: 早期且宽泛;语音控 agent 的体验未验证,而 agent 平台可能加原生远程控制。
